title: b7z9.37.2.2(a): C COSE decode + structural validation (root_dio_sig.c) + host vector test
description: Parent: project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.37.2.2. New C module lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/root_dio_sig.c/.h: minimal strict CBOR reader for the COSE_Sign1 Root DIO Signature (definite lengths only; tag-18 array(4): protected bstr->map{1:-65537}, unprotected map{4:kid bstr8}, payload bstr->map keys 1-7 with u8/u16/u64 range checks, signature bstr 48; duplicate labels, trailing bytes, indefinite lengths, and negatives for unsigned fields rejected fail-closed) + structural checks mirroring python verify_root_dio_signature:278-362: kid==IID(pubkey) via lichen_identity_iid_from_ed25519, DODAGID==ygg_addr(pubkey) via lichen_identity_ygg_addr_from_ed25519, expiry>now. Error reasons match vector expected.error strings. Host CMake test lichen/tests/rpl_root_sig/ extended with fixtures from test/vectors/root_dio_signature.json (valid basic, tampered->decode-ok, wrong_algorithm, kid_mismatch, impersonation, expiry boundary, garbage/trailing). Schnorr48 verify + replay + receiver wiring stay in sibling (b).
